note: A centre for every upazila, used to place a place with no known location (shown as "আনুমানিক অবস্থান"). For each OpenStreetMap admin_level=6 boundary, in this order: the BBS/HDX centre in data/locations.json (the pilot upazilas, as the site uses it); the boundary's admin_centre node; an OSM town/village node with the upazila's name; the upazila's police station or health complex; only then the polygon's centroid (or a point inside it). All must lie inside the boundary. Upazilas with no OSM boundary use the BBS/HDX centre in data/locations.json where it has one; the rest are listed under "missing" and in docs/DATA_GAPS.md. No centre is guessed.
